reviews.text: Dr. Kristin was an amazing help for us when putting down our senior dog at home. She was very empathetic and supportive to my family which made the experience much less painful. I felt she really honored my animal and respected him in his final moments. My pup was at peace and able to relax finally, very great service!
The staff was amazing! Caring, with us every step of the way. Explained everything. Very sad time but a good experience.

Not an awesome thing to go through but Dr. Tiffany was so compassionate through the entire process. Being able to let our baby go at home was easier on everyone. I would highly recommend them.

Great organization..wish I would have known they did hospice as my experience with hospice at restful pets was a nightmare..peaceful passings sent out 2 vets and a vet tech and they made the process so peaceful..so glad I found them only wish I would have found them earlier
